post.description: Always 204 on success. Then read GET /v1/auth/mfa: MFA_PENDING needs POST /v1/auth/mfa/verify within 5 minutes, ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED needs the TOTP setup and confirmation; until then other routes answer MFA_REQUIRED or MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED.

post.description: Needs the current TOTP code; the previous codes stop working.

post.description: Returns the secret and otpauth URI once; the pending secret expires in 10 minutes and only this session can confirm it. Replacing a confirmed factor (COMPLETE) requires its current code in the body; the old factor keeps working until confirmation.
